'''Martin Terwilliger''' of Albany played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000, finishing 9th with 8 points (+55).<ref name="ramapo2000">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ RamapoCon II Day 2 Director's Report], Scott Lingrell, DeckTech (13 May 2000).</ref>
